verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital products through LathamDrive, including a legal document generator, the Automated Convertible Note template tool and the Book of Jargon glossary apps, so AI-generated insights from user data is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows the product analyzes user data or produces AI-generated insights or suggestions. The document generators are template-driven form tools, not AI analysis.
